note: These are aggregates reported in the manuscript, not raw trial records. The individual videos in this repository are not linked to trial IDs.

simulation.source: Table III, native and matched Go2 tracks
simulation.scope: Traversal time is calculated only on the 180-task common-safe intersection. The Rollout-CBF 3D/posture version is an adaptation evaluated in this paper.

transfer.scope: Platform interfaces are calibrated; frozen core does not mean zero target adaptation.

hardware.scope: Gate benchmark: 30 low, 30 turning, and 30 successive-gate tasks. Pedestrian footage is a separate qualitative demonstration.

guarantee_scope: Conditional verified-segment clearance for static obstacles with valid body and sweep containment, model, support, map-error, timing, and queue assumptions.
